statements.quote: Our AI book of business now stands at more than $9.5 billion," said Arvind Krishna, IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer.
statements.notes: This is 'AI book of business', a cumulative inception-to-date measure combining signings/bookings and revenue. It is not revenue recognized in fiscal 2025 and should not be summed with revenue figures. 'More than $9.5 billion' is recorded as a lower bound. fiscal_year is null because the figure is cumulative and not tied to a period.
